links.outcome: Multilabel classification F1 of Llama 3.3 versus BoW, tf-idf, Clinical-Longformer on same notes
links.effect: Llama 3.3 micro F1 0.88 (HL 0.11) vs BoW 0.68, Clinical-Longformer 0.73, tf-idf 0.57 on the same 388 notes.
links.quote: Off-the-shelf autoregressive LLMs outperformed fined-tuned, encoder-only transformers and traditional natural language processing techniques in classifying operative notes.

unlisted_practices: Adding context/prompt information to LLM prompts to improve extraction performance
Manual error analysis of LLM misclassifications in operative notes

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of various NLP and LLM approaches (Llama 3, Clinical-Longformer, traditional NLP) on multilabel classification of surgical concepts from operative notes, focusing on standard accuracy metrics and error analysis without evaluating a deployment practice or safeguard.
